concept.name: Months of the Year
concept.description: The twelve named months of the annual cycle. A discrete named-category concept arranged in a repeating circle — months are positions in a cycle, not points on a spectrum.
concept.taxonomy_path: Temporal → Cyclical time → Months of the year
concept.notes: ROM-CR-MOY selected — months are a discrete named cyclical sequence. States mode only. January placed at top/start of cycle by convention. v1.1: corrected conceptData — rows were stored as [SL, TL, Quiz, Pos], violating the mandatory schema rule that column [0] is always TL. Swapped to [TL, SL, Quiz, Pos] to match CC-0002/CC-0006 convention. This was causing the App's injection remap (which assumes TL-first input) to double-swap the data, resulting in reversed TL/SL display and an English-answer quiz.
